publication_status: local draft; owner review and Firebase reauthentication required

scopes.purpose: Identify the Google account connected through the authorization-code flow. The stable subject ID keys the stored account.
Verify and display the connected account email so the user can identify the selected Google account.

Display upcoming events and create an event, with a selected notification offset, in the calendar explicitly chosen by the user. The UI supports choosing calendars available to the account; Google enforces the account's calendar access role. No attendees or event-update emails are added.
List the account's available calendar names, identifiers, access roles and timezones so the user can choose an event destination.
List task lists and tasks, create date-only tasks and change a task between needsAction and completed. The read-only scope cannot support creation or completion updates.

offline_access_purpose: Maintain the approved Google connection between local application sessions using a backend-encrypted refresh token. There is no scheduled two-way synchronization.
